listingDetails.title: OpenClaw - Personal AI Assistant
listingDetails.shortDescription: Run your own personal AI assistant on Azure. Connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord and 20+ channels to any AI model.
listingDetails.longDescription:
OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant gateway you run on your own Azure VM. It connects to the messaging channels you already use (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, iMessage, Microsoft Teams, Matrix, and 15+ more) and routes them to any AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and more).

Key Features:
• Multi-channel inbox — 20+ messaging platforms out of the box
• Any AI model — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, and local models
• Voice support — wake words on macOS/iOS, continuous voice on Android
• Live Canvas — agent-driven visual workspace
• Skills platform — extend with bundled or custom skills
• Privacy-first — your data stays on your own VM

This VM image ships with OpenClaw pre-installed and configured as a systemd service, so it starts automatically on boot. You only need to provide your API keys and messaging channel credentials after deployment.
